purpose: Test explicit evidence contracts across genuinely distinct held-out workflow policies and a direct authoritative-evidence intervention, rather than adding more refund wordings.
development_family: refund monetary eligibility and exact effects; CPU prompt/schema checks only
locked_families: room reservation: interval overlap, capacity and booking identity
inventory dispatch: per-SKU stock conservation, all-or-none fulfillment and policy reserve floors
support escalation: entitlement, priority-dependent required queue and SLA deadline
sampler: Eight parameterized logical pairs per held-out family, frozen seeds. Each pair has two separately instantiated SQLite worlds with identical pre-probe evidence and opposite postcondition truth because the authoritative policy changes. There are24pairs/48worlds, not48 independent workflow families.

evidence_channels.before_authoritative_probe: Actor-visible cached policy and committed-effect summary, explicitly missing the authoritative current policy/state requirements. One unique packet per twin pair:24native inputs/model. Exact pre-probe bytes must match across each pair and gold truth must differ.
evidence_channels.after_authoritative_probe: An actual SQLite read transaction captures the authoritative current policy and all contract-required committed state with entity, schema, epoch and revision binding.48native inputs/model. It adds information; pre/post gains are not equal-information algorithmic superiority.
evidence_channels.invalid_probe_controls: Twelve prespecified packets: four per held-out family, obtained by missing one required source, revision mismatch, source conflict and wrong entity binding. Required answer review; no outcome label is inserted in the packet.12native inputs/model.

oracle: Independent SQL queries against each database produce task labels. The verifier receives only JSON snapshots and a separately implemented typed public contract; private oracle labels, latent-world names and generator condition labels never enter its input.
methods: one frozen structured-verdict prompt per model
call_accounting: 2models x(24unique pre-probe+48complete+12invalid)=168. The identical twin pre-probe prediction is reused across its two worlds for the ambiguity diagnostic; it is not called twice or counted as independent evidence.

generation.output: strict JSON verdict accept/reject/review; confidence is not requested

metrics: complete-evidence correct accept/reject and true-correct-case acceptance
matched complete-evidence model versus typed decisions
no_tuning_rule: Freeze generator, policy contracts, SQLite oracle, packet manifest, prompts, model digests, case order and source SHA before locked inference. Any implementation failure remains versioned and reviewed before rerun; no model-output-driven prompt, case, model or threshold selection.
inference_boundary: Authored controlled workflows, trusted and transaction-consistent capture, explicit current-policy source assumptions. No deployment validity, real agent-rollout success, useful learned calibration or recovery of truly unavailable information is promised.
cpu_work_allowed_now: Implement fixtures, independent SQL oracle, typed checker and protocol/packet integrity checks without model calls.
model_launch_requirement: Independent plan review and explicit parent GPU GO. Root serializes with07/08.
